ex.en: Don't keep aerosol cans near heat.
ex.zh: 不要把噴霧罐放在熱源附近。

ex.en: Many aerosol sprays are not allowed on planes.
ex.zh: 很多噴霧劑不能帶上飛機。

aerosol.en: a container that sprays liquid as a fine mist

aesthetic.zh: 美學的、審美的；有美感的

ex.en: The building has great aesthetic appeal.
ex.zh: 這棟建築很有美感。

ex.en: We chose the design for aesthetic reasons.
ex.zh: 我們基於美觀考量選了這個設計。

aesthetic.en: of beauty and how things look

ex.en: I love the minimalist aesthetic of this café.
ex.zh: 我喜歡這家咖啡廳的極簡風格。

ex.en: The brand has a clean, modern aesthetic.
ex.zh: 這個品牌走簡潔現代的風格。

aesthetic.en: a particular idea or style of beauty

ex.en: The aeroplane landed smoothly despite the strong wind.
ex.zh: 儘管風很大，飛機還是平穩降落了。

ex.en: My little brother loves making paper aeroplanes.
ex.zh: 我弟弟很愛摺紙飛機。

ex.en: He works for an aerospace company that builds airplane parts.
ex.zh: 他在一家製造飛機零件的航太公司工作。

ex.en: The aerospace industry needs many skilled engineers.
ex.zh: 航太產業需要許多優秀的工程師。

ex.en: The film includes beautiful aerial views of the coast.
ex.zh: 這部電影有海岸的美麗空拍畫面。

ex.en: The army carried out an aerial survey of the area.
ex.zh: 軍方對該地區進行了空中勘測。

ex.en: We put an aerial on the roof to get better TV signals.
ex.zh: 我們在屋頂裝了天線，好讓電視訊號更好。

ex.en: The radio only works well when the aerial is pulled out.
ex.zh: 這台收音機要把天線拉出來才收得好。

ex.en: Swimming is a good aerobic exercise.
ex.zh: 游泳是很好的有氧運動。

ex.en: She takes an aerobic class three times a week.
ex.zh: 她每週上三次有氧課程。

ex.en: Aerobic exercise helps strengthen your heart.
ex.zh: 有氧運動有助於強化心臟。

ex.en: She studied aesthetics at university and loves art.
ex.zh: 她在大學主修美學，也熱愛藝術。

ex.en: The aesthetics of the building are simple and clean.
ex.zh: 這棟建築的美感簡約而乾淨。

ex.en: She goes to an aerobics class twice a week.
ex.zh: 她每週上兩次有氧舞蹈課。

ex.en: Aerobics is a fun way to keep your heart healthy.
ex.zh: 有氧運動是讓心臟保持健康的有趣方式。

ex.en: We spent our holiday on an Aegean island.
ex.zh: 我們在一座愛琴海島嶼度假。

ex.en: The Aegean coast of Turkey has many ancient ruins.
ex.zh: 土耳其的愛琴海沿岸有許多古代遺跡。

ex.en: The Aegean lies between Greece and Turkey.
ex.zh: 愛琴海位於希臘與土耳其之間。

ex.en: Ferries cross the Aegean every day in summer.
ex.zh: 夏天每天都有渡輪往返愛琴海。

ex.en: The new library is aesthetically pleasing and easy to use.
ex.zh: 新圖書館美觀又好用。

ex.en: The room was designed aesthetically, with soft light and simple furniture.
ex.zh: 這個房間在設計上很講究美感，有柔和的燈光與簡約的家具。

ex.en: The old aerodrome is now used by small private planes.
ex.zh: 那座舊機場現在供小型私人飛機使用。

ex.en: Pilots trained at the aerodrome outside the town.
ex.zh: 飛行員們在鎮外的小機場受訓。

aerodynamic.zh: 空氣動力學的；流線型的

ex.en: The car has an aerodynamic shape that reduces wind drag.
ex.zh: 這輛車有降低風阻的流線型外形。

ex.en: Engineers tested the aerodynamic design in a wind tunnel.
ex.zh: 工程師在風洞裡測試了這個空氣動力學設計。

ex.en: The project was carried out under the aegis of the university.
ex.zh: 這個計畫是在大學的庇護與支持下進行的。

ex.en: The festival runs under the aegis of the city council.
ex.zh: 這場節慶在市議會的主辦之下舉行。
